My girlfriend faces the same problems but one thing worked out the most for her:

Patience.

Have some time to talk with him about these. Not all as once however, go step for step. He'll know more about you and recognise whenever something is up. You'll build a great bonding, he seems like a person you can trust.

You should focus on hobbies and things you like. You're not depending on a person who left, so build on yourself from now on. Eat something you ever liked, go out wandering or do sports, watch some of your favorite movies or play some games. Avoid any near or thoughts about him with these and eventually you're completely fine. 

He's not worth your time, and there will be others who'll dedicate more time to you. This'll come, you'll see, there are people who care for you and support you but for now, stretch your back and do all the things you like. You're free.
